prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 行高瓶颈转移 · 故障复盘 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "模块" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "问题描述" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 578px
  col 3: header "影响范围" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 530px
  col 4: header "修复方案" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 659px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"通过故障复盘对照各模块的问题、影响和修复方案，验证行高瓶颈如何转移。","reading":"读者先按模块定位，再横向阅读同一行的描述、影响和方案；也可纵向比较各模块的影响或修复方式。截图中后两列的具体内容未完整显示，因此判断主要依据列标题和给定的内容宽度。","groups":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案共同构成每个故障的复盘链条，需要在同一行内保持清晰关联。","影响范围和修复方案都是对问题的后续说明，适合保留足够的阅读宽度。"],"keep_intact":["模块名称和列标题尽量完整显示。","数字、时间、单位及可能出现的标识符应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案中的中文叙述可自然换行。","较短单元格可以利用同一行中较长叙述产生的行高；具体换行效果取决于截图未完整显示的内容。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [52, 102, 100, 105] · table 360×671px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 222, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [52, 142, 75, 90] · table 360×810px · row heights [60, 153, 292, 269, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 12 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [52, 76, 81, 150] · table 360×857px · row heights [60, 315, 292, 153, 36] · column headers wrapped 2/4 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"四个表头均保持单行，模块列紧凑；三个叙述列宽度接近，使读者能沿行追踪问题、影响和修复，整体高度也是三者中最低的。","problems":"网关的问题描述、订单的影响范围和搜索的修复方案分别拉高各自行，短单元格因此留下大片空白；长叙述仍被切成较多短行。","cause":"问题描述、影响范围和修复方案分别只有102、100、105px，三列的长内容都受到约束，但没有一列明显挤压其他列。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"问题描述较宽，网关行的叙述更容易阅读，行高也比r0A低。模块列和修复方案表头保持单行。","problems":"影响范围表头换行，订单的影响叙述变成狭长的文本带；搜索行的修复叙述也很拥挤，使表格明显变高，横向阅读节奏失衡。","cause":"问题描述增至142px，挤压影响范围至75px、修复方案至90px；其中75px不足以容纳完整的四字表头。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"修复方案有较充裕的宽度，搜索行的长方案更易阅读，网关的短方案也能保持一行。","problems":"问题描述和影响范围的表头都换行；网关与订单的长叙述形成很高的窄列，搜索的短描述也被拆行，整表高度最大。","cause":"修复方案占用150px，问题描述和影响范围分别缩至76px和81px，导致前两列成为主要行高瓶颈。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-fix","widths":[52,100,98,109],"change":"以r0A为基础，略微增加修复方案宽度，缓解搜索行的长叙述，同时保留三个叙述列的单行表头。"},{"name":"balanced-impact","widths":[52,98,105,104],"change":"将少量宽度转给影响范围，尝试压缩订单行的长叙述，观察其他两行是否仍能保持合理高度。"},{"name":"description-lean","widths":[52,112,96,99],"change":"适度加宽问题描述以改善网关行，同时给影响和方案列保留足够宽度显示完整表头，探索比r0B温和的分配。"}]}
